bullets.text: Measured: 2026-11-20 on akiendell (Windows), at main d4b139be4: with CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT pointing at an empty temp directory, 'bash bin/cairn probescan' leaves 58 entries under it (bin/cairn _floor_instance sources bootstrap.sh and runs cairn_wire_instances), and 'bin\cairn.cmd probescan' leaves 0. cairn.cmd now runs bin/cairn.py, which ports the dispatch but not the floor's wiring, so a fresh Windows instance root is no longer wired by typing cairn. Landed by ticket 380d524e6e9c.
